title: Front Suspension Diagnosis
introduction:
Springs support the load, dampers control motion, and arms and links guide the wheels. I keep those jobs separate when considering a clunk, uneven tire wear or repeated bouncing. The loudest part of the complaint doesn't necessarily name the culprit—suspension diagnosis isn't a shouting contest.

This page directs you to the required suspension diagnostic procedure. Its preparation, checks, result interpretation and decision branches are unavailable here, so this referral cannot serve as a standalone diagnostic walkthrough.

edits.text: For front-suspension diagnosis, refer to [Suspension System](#/document/G1686610) (204-00 Suspension System - General Information, Diagnosis and Testing).
edits.why: The required reference provides the diagnostic route for connecting a suspension complaint to the appropriate checks and next branch. This referral alone cannot identify a faulty component or justify replacement.
